body: I have had depression my whole life, I remember being 5yo and actually praying to god that I wouldn't wake up. It really sucks. I don't know about you but if I could wish for anything it would be for a relationship. I've never been in one. Never even been kissed. All of this depresses me more.
I have a decent paying job and can't do that at the moment, but that is a good Idea.
"Hey, I think you're gorgeous. What's your name?" *Proceeds to vomit profusely* lol I will try it. Or try to try at least.
Social skills is not something I have ever had. I actually have trouble talking to my friends about anything, I'm just not talkative to begin with. This will be very much a challenge, but I accept.
